svg.title: Møller’s sphere–torus gluing configuration
svg.desc: A shaded view of the radius-two sphere and numerical Angenent torus, with both intersection circles in red. The right panel shows their meridians. This is the singular input before handle insertion, not a computed high-genus shrinker.

g.text: Red circles are overlaid through the surfaces.
No finite-genus shrinker is computed. See Møller, Figures 1–2.
